title: Strategic Account Director
description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

 

Location: London

Hybrid

Full-Time

 

The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit — from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.

This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.

This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.

 

What You'll Do 

 

  • Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. Own a new-business quota. Identify, prioritize, and pursue the highest-value target accounts in your territory (typically $500K+/month cross-border volume, up to $10M+/month strategic targets) and convert them into signed, funded customers.
  • Generate your own pipeline. Build top-of-funnel through disciplined, research-led outbound — direct executive outreach, referrals, partner and ecosystem channels, and events. Do not wait for leads; create them.
  • Break into the buying committee cold. Get in front of and build conviction with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Operations, and Compliance/Risk leaders at target accounts. Multi-thread deliberately so a deal never rests on a single contact.
  • Displace the incumbent. Position Payoneer's speed, global coverage, economics, and platform breadth to unseat incumbent banks and specialist competitors. Run competitive displacement plays and build the business case that moves an entrenched buyer.
  • Own complex, long-cycle deals end to end. Drive multi-stakeholder, technical, compliance-sensitive evaluations from first meeting to close. Own the mutual close plan, procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation.
  • Sell the platform. Lead with value, not features. Land the entry wedge and architect the deal to open cross-border payments plus high-value services (Capital, Treasury/FX, Embedded/Platform Payments, Workforce/EOR, and emerging rails) — maximizing initial contract value and expansion potential.
  • Qualify with discipline. Apply Payoneer's Sandler-based methodology — Up-Front Contracts, Pain Funnel, budget and decision qualification — to every pursuit so you invest team resources only in winnable, real deals.
  • Orchestrate the pursuit team. Direct Solutions/Pre-Sales, Product Specialists, Compliance, and RevOps as a coordinated deal team through the sales cycle, and quarterback executive sponsorship where needed.
  • Forecast honestly and close on time. Own a credible, hygienic pipeline and forecast in CRM. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight.
  • Set up the win for the long term. Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.

 

 

Who You Are 

  • 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition — not primarily account management or renewals.
  • Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals.
  • Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level.
  • Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value.
  • Demonstrated success selling into and navigating executive buying committees — CFO, Treasury, Finance, Compliance/Risk.
  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including running procurement, legal, and margin-protective deal structuring to close.
  • Fluency operating in a matrix environment and orchestrating a cross-functional pursuit team.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

 

Preferred

  • Background in payments, fintech, banking, treasury, FX, or cross-border commerce.
  • Track record of competitive displacement against incumbent banks or specialist fintechs.
  • Experience selling a multi-product platform and structuring land-and-expand entry deals.
  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (Payoneer uses Sandler).
  • Exposure to compliance-sensitive, regulated sales environments (KYC/AML-aware selling).
  • Strong CRM discipline and data-driven pipeline management (e.g., Salesforce).

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build each other up 
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.

Technical Delivery

  • Build dashboards and reports that communicate customer performance clearly

  • Proven ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership
  • Experience with ecommerce analytics — conversion, funnel and site performance metrics
  • Skilled at synthesising quantitative data with qualitative insight to form a complete view of customer behaviour

Desirable

  • Familiarity with CRM or marketing automation platforms
  • Experience with Tableau or equivalent BI tooling

  • Accountable for own targets — delivers high-quality analysis with minimal supervision

description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation The Opportunity This is one of the highest-leverage commercial roles in the business. As Commercial Director, you'll own the entire sales system at Relay — strategy, structure, process, and performance across all four of our segments: Pitstop/Field Sales, Enterprise, Large Parcel, and SME Parcel. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results. Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role. What You'll Own Sales strategy and structure Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments — how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve Data and performance management Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back — instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it Process, structure, and scalability Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount Team leadership and org design Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well Global and remote team leadership Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe Proven capability to do this is a requirement — it can't be learned on the job here Exec partnership and GTM planning Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic Who Will Thrive in This Role Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion — for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales. You're comfortable setting standards and managing performance across both. You've carried a number yourself and led others doing the same. This isn't a role for a single-lane specialist. Data-driven and structured operator. You define the metrics that matter, build or oversee the dashboards, and use data to make resourcing and process calls — not gut feel alone. You have a track record of introducing or significantly upgrading forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, territory design, and comp structures in ways that improved consistency and scalability. You think in systems across a multi-year horizon, not just the next quarter. Global and remote team builder. You've led sales teams across multiple geographies or time zones, ideally including the US and Europe. You're comfortable setting standards, culture, and expectations remotely. Having helped take a company into a new country is a bonus; the core requirement is proven capability. People leader and org designer. You've led sales managers or leaders — not just individual contributors — and operated at least one layer removed from the front line. You have a track record of hiring and developing leaders beneath you, and making clear calls about what to centralise versus what to delegate. Exec partner. You've partnered directly with a CEO, founder, or C-suite on revenue planning and commercial trade-offs. You can push back on unrealistic targets while maintaining trust, and you can translate company strategy into an actionable, sequenced sales roadmap. Builder, not just operator. You've introduced new process, data infrastructure, or org structure in a previous role — not only operated within a system someone else built. This role is not about being a super-IC closer or a sector-pedigree hire; logistics experience is welcome but not a requirement or a filter. Compensation, Benefits & Workplace Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success. Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it. 25 days of holidays Enhanced parental leave. Hardware of your choice. Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more). Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. You'll set the standards that let each segment lead build well, and you'll be personally accountable for the sum of the results.

Beyond the day-to-day, this role has a genuine builder's brief: creating the infrastructure and team capabilities that take Relay international over the next few years. If you want to shape how a fast-growing carrier goes to market at scale — and leave a lasting mark on how that machine works — this is the role.

What You'll Own

Sales strategy and structure

  • Design the shape of Relay's sales organisation across all four segments — how they relate, where they overlap, how resource is prioritised

  • Define the sales motion for each segment: who it sells to, how, and through which channel

  • Keep strategy current as the business and market evolve

Data and performance management

  • Set the metrics that matter across pipeline, conversion, quota attainment, and productivity

  • Build or oversee the dashboards that surface them

  • Use data to make decisions on resourcing, territory design, and where to invest or pull back — instinct complements data here, it doesn't replace it

Process, structure, and scalability

  • Own the sales playbook, forecasting cadence, deal review process, CRM hygiene standards, and comp and quota-setting principles

  • Upskill and coach the existing team on pitch, process, and performance

  • Build infrastructure that scales for the next three years, not just today's headcount

Team leadership and org design

  • Lead the four segment sales leads (Pitstop/Field, Enterprise, Large Parcel, SME Parcel) and any central sales ops or enablement partners

  • Decide what's centralised across functions versus what each segment lead owns locally

  • Hire, develop, and coach those leads so each can build out their patch well

Global and remote team leadership

  • Lead teams remotely across time zones and geographies as Relay expands into the Americas and Europe

  • Proven capability to do this is a requirement — it can't be learned on the job here

Exec partnership and GTM planning

  • Partner with the CCO and other function leads on revenue planning, headcount decisions, and commercial trade-offs

  • Translate company strategy into a sequenced sales roadmap and GTM direction

  • Push back clearly when targets or timelines aren't realistic

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Multi-motion sales leader. You've led more than one kind of sales motion — for example, high-volume SMB or transactional sales alongside enterprise or mid-market relationship-led sales. You're comfortable setting standards and managing performance across both. You've carried a number yourself and led others doing the same. This isn't a role for a single-lane specialist.

  • Data-driven and structured operator. You define the metrics that matter, build or oversee the dashboards, and use data to make resourcing and process calls — not gut feel alone. You have a track record of introducing or significantly upgrading forecasting discipline, CRM hygiene, territory design, and comp structures in ways that improved consistency and scalability. You think in systems across a multi-year horizon, not just the next quarter.

  • Global and remote team builder. You've led sales teams across multiple geographies or time zones, ideally including the US and Europe. You're comfortable setting standards, culture, and expectations remotely. Having helped take a company into a new country is a bonus; the core requirement is proven capability.

  • People leader and org designer. You've led sales managers or leaders — not just individual contributors — and operated at least one layer removed from the front line. You have a track record of hiring and developing leaders beneath you, and making clear calls about what to centralise versus what to delegate.

  • Exec partner. You've partnered directly with a CEO, founder, or C-suite on revenue planning and commercial trade-offs. You can push back on unrealistic targets while maintaining trust, and you can translate company strategy into an actionable, sequenced sales roadmap.

  • Builder, not just operator. You've introduced new process, data infrastructure, or org structure in a previous role — not only operated within a system someone else built. This role is not about being a super-IC closer or a sector-pedigree hire; logistics experience is welcome but not a requirement or a filter.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.

  • Hardware of your choice.

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

The Opportunity We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside. At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks. You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets. We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go. We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving. What You’ll Be Doing • Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work. • Keep our databases fast and reliable. • Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines. • Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go. • Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required. • Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics. • Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code. • Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering. • Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed. Our Stack • Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go. • Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API. • Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch. • Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build. • Front end: TypeScript and React. • Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape. What We’re Looking For • Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus. • Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL. • Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus. • Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength. • A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery. • Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment. • Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python. • A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio. Why Join Us? • Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details] • A small team working with major enterprise clients. • Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale. • Full autonomy and full ownership of your work. • High standards, trust and plenty of humour. • The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres. • Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This role is for builders who thrive in 0→1. In Axon’s Global Artificial Intelligence pillar, you’ll build a stealth product with a small team and a big mission: deliver something the market hasn’t seen, and do it with pace.

As a Senior Software Engineer I, you’ll lead key areas of the product from concept through launch. You’ll make pragmatic architecture decisions, keep quality high while moving fast, and help the team turn prototypes into a scalable product. 

This is an AI-native delivery role: AI is a primary lever for how you ship, not an add-on and you have true Product acumen and ability to craft and build products end to end. 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the build of major product surfaces and services; own features end-to-end from design to operations.
  • Drive product clarity in ambiguity: define the problem, shape MVP scope, set success metrics, and align stakeholders on what “done” means.
  • Build and ship software AI-natively across the SDLC (planning, implementation, testing, code review, debugging, and operations), with clear validation practices to maintain correctness and quality.
  • Measure and improve delivery outcomes using engineering metrics (lead time, PR throughput, defect rates, test coverage, incident load) and iterate on how the team ships.
  • Make architecture choices that balance speed and scalability—knowing when “temporary” becomes “permanent.”
  • Build and enforce engineering hygiene that doesn’t slow you down (testing strategy, CI/CD, observability, sensible release practices).
  • Partner tightly with Product and Design (and operate effectively when they’re not in the room) to prioritise, sequence, and ship the highest-value increments.
  • Mentor engineers and help establish a high-trust, high-ownership culture.

Work Location: This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.
Reports to: SVP, AI

What You Bring

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including ownership of product capabilities in production.
  • Demonstrated, heavy AI-native delivery: consistent use of AI across the SDLC with concrete examples of faster delivery and maintained/improved quality.
  • Strong engineering judgement under uncertainty; ability to simplify and still build something great.
  • Experience building cloud-native services and/or modern user experiences that scale.
  • Comfort working across boundaries: product, design, customers, and platform dependencies.
  • Product judgement sufficient to ship: ability to frame problems, define MVP scope, make trade-offs, and drive to measurable customer outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Startup or internal incubation experience.
  • Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into product experiences responsibly.
  • Track record of accelerating teams through strong technical leadership.
  • Experience operating in PM-light environments where engineers help drive prioritisation and discovery alongside delivery.

Benefits that benefit you

  • Competitive base salary and RSUs
  • Comprehensive pension plan with matching contribution
  • Private health insurance & cash plans
  • 30 days paid holiday + UK public holidays
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave
  • GymPass subscription
  • Life assurance & income protection
  • Career growth support and wellness resources

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

 

 

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

title: AI Systems - Senior Software Engineer
description:
At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

 

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on our AI Systems team, you'll build the AI foundations and product experiences of Ledgy: the Ledgy Agent, the tools and skills it runs on, our MCP server, and the platform capabilities that let other teams embed AI safely in their domains. You'll collaborate with fellow engineers, product managers, and designers in a new and fast-moving product area where correctness matters as much as speed - our customers need equity data they can trust.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

The team you'll join:
AI Systems - Develops Ledgy's AI foundations and product experiences, from AI agents and AI-assisted workflows to the platform capabilities that help other teams embed AI safely in their domains. The team works in a new and evolving product area, balancing rapid iteration with reliable execution, evaluation tooling, and responsible automation.

What You'll Work On

Help build the future of how companies manage equity.

  • Ledgy Agent. You'll design and build the system behind our in-app agent, so equity administrators can do through AI what they do manually in the app today. Ledgy Agent takes real actions and runs real analysis on live equity data, like onboarding a stakeholder end to end, and administrators depend on its accuracy and observability. You'll design the tools, skills, context, and orchestration behind it, and how it decides to handle each request.
  • Ledgy MCP. Not everyone wants to open Ledgy to get things done. Our MCP server lets customers bring equity into the AI agents and tools they already use. You'll shape it alongside the in-app agent, so a capability built once works in both places, and you'll decide what we expose and how we keep it safe.
  • Measuring and improving the agent. You'll design and build the system we use to measure the agent's quality and learn from how customers use it: evaluations, tracing, and feedback from real conversations. You decide what "good" means for customers, how we measure it, and how what we learn changes what we build next.
  • Scaling. The Ledgy web application, the agent, MCP, and surfaces we haven't built yet all need the same capabilities. You'll design the foundations that let us build AI features once and reuse them everywhere, and that let other teams add AI to their domains without compromising correctness. You'll also design how it runs as usage grows: the backend infrastructure, cost, and latency behind the agent and MCP, and how we keep them reliable and observable.

You'll own real parts of this and have a say in where we invest. You'll also spend time with customers to see how administrators actually use the agent, and use that to decide what to build next.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. These are the things that would make you an especially good fit.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer, with strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals across back end and front end
  • You've built and shipped agentic or LLM-based software to production, such as an agent, an assistant, or a chat product, and you've been the one running it. You've debugged failures in real conversations and kept cost and latency in check as usage and models changed.
  • You've designed the agent itself: tools and skills, context and prompt engineering, state, streaming, and the agent loop. You know at least one agent framework or runtime well and can say where it works and where it doesn't.
  • You improve these systems with evidence. Evals, regression sets, tracing, and feedback from real usage tell you whether a change helped, and you use them to decide what to do next.
  • You keep up with what the foundation labs and the wider community are learning about building agents. You try new techniques early and judge which ones make our product better and are worth adopting now, and which should wait.
  • You take part in deciding what we build. You read the data, talk to customers, and push for what you think matters most.

Our Tech Stack

We work in a TypeScript monorepo: React and Tailwind on the front end, tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, and Temporal on the back end. It runs on GCP with Kubernetes, managed through Terraform. The agent is currently built on the Vercel AI SDK, and we run an MCP server alongside it.

You don't need to know all of it, but hands-on experience building with LLMs is strongly preferred.

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First day: Get the app running locally and make your first commit. Your onboarding buddy helps you get there.

First week:

  • Meet the engineers, product managers, and designers you'll work with.
  • Learn the agent end to end: its tools, skills, MCP surface, and how we evaluate it.
  • Ship a few smaller features.

First month:

  • Meet the wider engineering team and learn how Ledgy works and how customers use it today. This is the background you'll use for decisions later.
  • Make larger contributions and take a bigger part in code reviews.

First 3 months:

  • Drive part of a larger piece of work, such as process, tooling, a new product, or new functionality.
  • Work with Product and Design to prove and deepen the value AI adds to the product.
  • Take part in architecture and long-term decisions.

After the first 3 months:

  • Take a bigger role in shaping where the team is heading. Own key parts of our AI platform and decide where we can add the most value for customers.
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the bar. Help teams across Ledgy add AI to what they build, whether that means advising, reviewing, or working alongside them.
  • Help shape Ledgy's technical direction, for AI and for everything else we build.

The interview process:

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session where you will design an architecture for a problem from the Ledgy domain using a visual tool of your choice
  • Behavioural (45 min): Answer behavioural style questions about your experience, using the STAR method - with a PM and EM.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy's mission and values

Being part of Ledgy means:

At Ledgy, we’re on a mission to make Europe a powerhouse of entrepreneurship by building a modern, tech-driven equity management and financial reporting platform for private and public companies. In 2026, we aim to be the leading provider for European IPOs and reporting for share-based payments. We are a value-based company with a core focus on being humble, transparent, ambitious and impactful, all in order to delivery the best experience for our customers and end users.

We are proud to partner with some of the world’s leading investors. New Enterprise Associates led our $22m Series B round in 2022, with Philip Chopin joining Sequoia’s Luciana Lixandru on our board.

We were founded in Switzerland in 2017 and today we operate globally from offices in Zurich and London. We encourage diversity and are an international team coming from 26 different countries and speaking 25 different languages.

 

About the role

As a Mid-level Software Engineer at Ledgy, you’ll build reliable, scalable product experiences that help companies manage their equity with confidence. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers to turn complex equity workflows into clear, automated, user-friendly software.

This role is a strong fit if you’re ready to take ownership of well-scoped projects, grow your technical judgement, and contribute across the stack while learning from senior peers.

Location: We hire remotely across the UK, Spain, Germany, Poland, and Romania. For candidates based in London, we use a hybrid model with 2 days in the office per week.

Teams we are hiring for:

  • Core Equity — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. This team defines and maintains the transaction logic, data model, and core domain behaviour that ensure Ledgy’s platform remains accurate, scalable, and compliant. They also enable employees to sell their shares seamlessly once vested.
  • Workflows & Automation — Focuses on automating complex equity workflows and integrating with third-party services, including the trading exchange. The team builds systems that help company admins efficiently onboard and offboard employees, automate equity grants and terminations.
  • Reporting — Transforms Ledgy’s core equity data into financial, operational, and compliance reports. The team manages large, complex datasets and ensures reporting is accurate, performant, and reliable across jurisdictions and company structures. Their work powers the insights companies and auditors rely on for decision-making and transparency.
  • Tax — Ensures taxes are correctly reflected throughout equity operations, especially moments such as exercising, selling, mobility, and other taxable events. As a future team, Tax will build end-to-end product capabilities across the stack, helping customers manage complex tax and compliance requirements accurately across jurisdictions.

You will thrive in the role if you

  • You have 3+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer
  • You are comfortable building and shipping production-quality features across the stack
  • You enjoy learning complex domains and turning them into simple, maintainable product experiences
  • You care about clean, tested, readable code and thoughtful collaboration
  • You are curious about equity, financial workflows, and their real-world impact on companies and employees
  • You’re excited to grow your technical judgement through code reviews, pairing, and architecture discussions
  • You take ownership of your work while asking for input early when trade-offs are unclear

Our Tech Stack*:

We have a modern, cohesive stack that lets us move fast while maintaining quality:

  • Language: TypeScript
  • Frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, tRPC
  • Backend: tRPC, Node.js, MongoDB, Temporal
  • Infrastructure: GCP, Terraform Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions

*We don’t expect proficiency in this specific stack

What Your Journey Could Look Like

First 30 days:

  • Be paired with an onboarding buddy who will introduce you to the world of equity management
  • Get to know your engineering team, product managers, and designers
  • Learn how your team’s domain connects to the broader Ledgy platform
  • Set up your development environment and start contributing small, well-scoped changes
  • Build familiarity with our codebase, product workflows, and engineering practices

First 3 months:

  • Ship product features and improvements with increasing independence
  • Work with teammates to break down problems, understand trade-offs, and deliver reliable solutions
  • Participate actively in code reviews and team discussions
  • Develop a deeper understanding of how companies manage and automate equity
  • Contribute to improving quality, maintainability, and user experience in your team’s domain

First 6–12 months:

  • Own medium-sized features from implementation through release
  • Collaborate with Product and Design to shape pragmatic, user-centric solutions
  • Contribute to technical discussions around data models, workflows, and scalability
  • Continue growing toward senior-level ownership, judgement, and impact

The interview process:

  • Getting to know you (45 min): Meet with someone from our people team to talk about your experience and to ask questions about the role
    • Hackerrank take-home assessment (30-45mins) - this is a test to assess core coding cability
  • Live Coding (60 min): An equity domain problem to solve collaboratively using your preferred language and IDE. We want to see how you think, so this step does not allow AI. But you can freely look up syntax questions if you need to.
  • System Design (60 min): A system design session focused on practical problem-solving, clear trade-offs, and how you structure technical thinking
  • Behavioural (45 min): Answer behavioural style questions about your experience, using the STAR method - with a PM and EM.
  • Culture Interview: A chance to meet one of our founders and your hiring manager for a 30-minute chat about Ledgy’s mission and values
  • Offer 🎉

 

Being part of Ledgy means:

  • Recharge and re-energize with flexible working hours, 25 days of vacation, and up to 40 days of remote work from outside your home country.
  • We make space for your own professional development, with a generous yearly learning & development budget.
  • This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. All salaries are aligned with competitively benchmarked ranges based on work location and levelling.
  • For candidates based in London or Zurich we use a hybrid work model of 2 days in the office per week.

description: Le département Sales compte une trentaine de personnes réparties entre la qualification des prospects et le closing. Leur objectif commun : accompagner les prospects jusqu’à la signature du contrat en Assemblée Générale. Notre cycle de vente est long et complexe en BtoC (3 à 4 mois en moyenne). La particularité ? La copropriété doit voter à la majorité lors de son assemblée générale pour souscrire à notre solution. En tant qu’ alternant·e Sales Development Representative , tu es le premier point de contact et le premier maillon de notre chaîne commerciale. Ton rôle est stratégique : transformer l’intérêt d’un prospect en une opportunité commerciale réelle pour les Account Executives. Il existe 600.000 copropriétés en France et chacune d’elle constitue une communauté à part entière, dont il nous faut comprendre le fonctionnement afin de les convaincre de nous rejoindre ! Nos prospects peuvent aussi bien être une petite copropriété de 3 lots en zone rurale, déjà autonome, qu’un grand ensemble immobilier de 300 logements en centre-ville, géré par un professionnel en face duquel nous présenterons une offre concurrente. Tes missions en soutien de l'équipe Sales En binôme avec nos commerciaux et sous la responsabilité de ton/ta manager, tu seras formé·e pour découvrir le métier de Sales Development Representative (SDR). Tes missions consisteront à : • Prendre en main la qualification : Réaliser les premiers échanges téléphoniques avec les prospects ayant formulé une demande de devis pour instaurer un premier contact de confiance. • Comprendre les besoins : T'entraîner à analyser les problématiques rencontrées au sein des copropriétés et présenter les offres Matera. • Assister les Account Executives : Participer à la prise de rendez-vous de démonstration et épauler les AE dans le suivi des prospects, la préparation des assemblées générales et les tâches administratives. • Découvrir nos outils Sales : Participer à la tenue à jour de notre CRM (Hubspot) et appliquer les bonnes pratiques de suivi. • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue : Proposer tes idées et participer aux projets internes visant à fluidifier nos processus commerciaux. Ton parcours d'intégration & d'apprentissage : • Deux semaines d'immersion : Découverte de nos métiers, de nos équipes et de notre vision globale. • Intégration à la Sales Academy : Tout du long de ta formation, tu bénéficieras d'un accompagnement sur mesure (formations techniques sur la copropriété, ateliers pratiques sur les méthodes de vente). • Suivi régulier : Des échanges hebdomadaires avec ton/ta manager pour accompagner ta montée en compétences et lever tes blocages. • Perspective d'évolution : En fonction de ta progression et de ton projet, tu pourras élargir ton champ d'apprentissage en découvrant les étapes suivantes du cycle de vente auprès de nos Account Executives. Les avantages : Les plus : Salaire : selon grille syntec Une forte montée en compétence sur les métiers de Sales, la vente complexe, la connaissance de l’environnement start-up et immobilier, Poursuite possible en CDI avec évolution en Account Executive par la suite. Wellpass pour faire du sport à petits prix Tickets resto (Swile) - pris en charge à 50% Accès à la plateforme Leeto pour avoir accès à des activités à prix réduit via le CSE Temps de Trajet Responsable (TTR) : 1 jour de congé supplémentaire par an, découpable en 2 demi-journées et rémunéré comme un congé payé, pour inciter à choisir des modes de transports responsables, Congés menstruels : 1 jour de congé par mois, pour mieux gérer les règles douloureuses, La base légale : Prise en charge des transports à 50% Mutuelle & Carte Swile - pris en charge à 50% Prise en charge de la prévoyance à 100% Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis Informations pratiques : Localisation : Paris 10e Type de contrat : Alternance (un ou deux ans) Date de démarrage : Octobre 2026 Rythme obligatoire : 3 semaines en entreprise / une semaine à l’école. Idéalement, tu : As un bon relationnel, tu es à l’écoute et tu te sens à l’aise au téléphone Aimes trouver des solutions pour tes clients et tu aimes convaincre ton audience As envie de monter en compétences et d’évoluer sur les métiers Sales Recherches une alternance d’un ou deux ans et tu parles français couramment Bonus : tu as déjà réalisé des jobs étudiant/ jobs d’été/ missions d’interim’ (restauration, vente, accueil, événementiel, animation, etc.) Tu hésites entre les challenges de la vente complexe en B2C et le plaisir de parler à des individus très différents pour les fédérer autour d’un projet ? Tu apprécies autant les outils digitaux que rencontrer tes prospects là où ils se trouvent ? Tu rêves d’une équipe où tout le monde s’entraide pour atteindre et dépasser ses objectifs, sans oublier de passer de bons moments ensemble, pendant ou après les heures de bureau ? De participer à la création d’un leader européen des services immobiliers ? Ne cherche plus et postule pour nous rejoindre ! Entretien téléphonique avec un.e recruteuse (15-20 min) Entretien technique avec deux Account Executive pour une mise en situation en visio (30 min) Rencontre nos Sales Manager, Inès , Justine Offre sous 24/48h 🎉 Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Dabei verbinden wir die organisatorische, technische und psychosoziale Dimension, denn Veränderung gelingt nur, wenn die Menschen mitgehen.

Namhafte Kunden aus Logistik, Finanzen und Industrie begleiten wir als Partner über den gesamten Transformationszyklus, auch über den Go-Live hinaus. Wir hören zu und sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Intern erwarten Dich flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein direkter Draht zum Gründer.

Für unser Team KI & Software Engineering suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die zentrale Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure bei unseren Kunden konzipiert, aufbaut und fachlich verantwortet – von der Anbindung der Quellsysteme bis zum fertigen Dashboard. Typische Einsatzfelder liegen bei Kunden aus Logistik, Finanzen und Industrie, etwa die Zusammenführung von Unternehmens- und Maschinendaten auf einer gemeinsamen Plattform. Mit wachsender Erfahrung entwickelst Du Dich in der Fachlaufbahn zum Principal Architect Data & Cloud weiter.

Das sind Deine Aufgaben

  • Du konzipierst zentrale Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure, baust sie auf und entwickelst sie weiter – fachlich verantwortlich gegenüber dem Kunden, eigenständig oder als Senior im Projektteam.

  • Du bindest Unternehmenssysteme und Maschinendaten über Schnittstellen an und modellierst die Daten so, dass sie für KI-Anwendungen, Auswertungen und Dashboards bereitstehen.

  • Du baust für unsere Kunden die Cloud-Infrastruktur mit Infrastructure as Code auf und automatisierst Bereitstellung und Betrieb über CI/CD.

  • Du setzt Sicherheit, Berechtigungen und Mandantentrennung um, sodass jede Nutzergruppe genau die Daten sieht, die sie sehen darf.

  • Du wirkst im Pre-Sales mit, baust Wissen im Team auf und entwickelst unser Daten- und Cloud-Angebot weiter.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Data Engineer in der Cloud (idealerweise 4+ Jahre), idealerweise in Microsoft Azure, mit sehr guten Kenntnissen in SQL und Python

  • Erfahrung mit Datenintegration über Schnittstellen sowie mit Datenmodellierung und Reporting, idealerweise mit Power BI

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code und CI/CD sowie gute Kenntnisse in Cloud-Sicherheit und Berechtigungskonzepten, idealerweise mit Entra ID

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch (C1) für die Arbeit mit unseren Kunden

  • Den Wunsch, Dich in der Fachlaufbahn zum Principal Architect Data & Cloud weiterzuentwickeln

Das ist ein Plus

Kein Muss, aber ein Plus – wenn Du die Kriterien oben erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung:

  • Praxis mit Microsoft Fabric – alternativ mit Azure Synapse oder Databricks und die Bereitschaft, auf Fabric umzusteigen

  • Grundlagen in Machine Learning

  • Erfahrung mit Maschinen- und IoT-Daten, z.B. über OPC UA, MQTT oder Azure IoT Hub

  • Branchenkenntnisse in Logistik, Finanzen oder Industrie

Das bieten wir

  • Gehalt und Vorsorge: Zielgehalt von 70.000–100.000 € brutto pro Jahr je nach Erfahrung, inklusive variabler Vergütung nach Projekt- und Unternehmenserfolg, plus betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss

  • Karriere: Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad zum Principal Architect Data & Cloud mit transparenten Kriterien und regelmäßigen Entwicklungsgesprächen

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du prägst Architektur und Vorgehen unserer Datenplattform-Projekte und hast echten Einfluss auf unser Daten- und Cloud-Angebot

  • Weiterbildung und Sichtbarkeit: Persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, bezahlte Zertifizierungen (z.B. Microsoft Azure und Fabric) und Raum für Konferenzen, Fachbeiträge und Vorträge

  • Reisen: Bis zu 20 % Deiner Arbeitszeit beim Kunden vor Ort

  • Arbeitsort und Flexibilität: Büro in Berlin-Wilmersdorf (direkt an der U7/U9 Berliner Straße), plus ein Homeoffice-Tag pro Woche,

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Arbeitszeitkonto, Voll- oder Teilzeit sowie bis zu 2 Wochen Workation pro Jahr im EU-Ausland

  • Urlaub, Ausstattung und Extras: 28 Tage Urlaub, Mac oder PC nach Wahl, Firmenmobiltelefon, Mobilitätszuschuss, flexible Benefits über ProBonio inklusive Gesundheit und Sport sowie regelmäßige Teamevents

Unsere Werte

Unser Markenkern: Partnerschaft. Ob mit Kunden, Kolleg:innen oder Forschungspartnern – wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe und auf Dauer. Drei Werte machen das konkret:

Zuhören: Wir verstehen erst, dann gestalten wir. Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden und nehmen die Menschen mit – im Projekt wie im eigenen Team.

Substanz: Wir arbeiten wissenschaftlich fundiert, sorgfältig und technologisch auf der Höhe der Zeit. Wir empfehlen nur, was wir begründen können.

Verbindlichkeit: Wir übernehmen Verantwortung, als wäre es unser eigenes Unternehmen. Wir halten, was wir zusagen, und bleiben, wenn es darauf ankommt – beim Kunden über den Go-Live hinaus und füreinander im Team.

title: Regional Field CTO
description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Regional Field Chief Technology Officer

Location: EMEA, Remote (Black Duck has entities in UK, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden)

 

Black Duck® meets the board-level risks of modern software with True Scale Application Security, ensuring uncompromised trust in software for the regulated, AI-powered world. Only Black Duck solutions free organizations from tradeoffs between speed, accuracy, and compliance at scale while eliminating security, regulatory, and licensing risks. Whether in the cloud or on premises, Black Duck is the only choice for securing mission-critical software everywhere code happens. With Black Duck, security leaders can make smarter decisions and unleash business innovation with confidence.

 

We are looking for a Regional Field Chief Technology Officer to serve as a senior technical executive, trusted advisor, and public voice of our technology strategy in the market. In this role, the Regional Field CTO will operate at the intersection of technology, sales, and the customer — engaging directly with C-level and technical leaders at our most strategic customer accounts, translating our AI-driven platform capabilities into credible technical narratives, and representing the company as a thought leader across the industry. This is a customer-facing, pre-sales technical leadership role reporting to the VP of Sales Engineering, with a dotted line to Product & Technology.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor and recurring executive sponsor for C-level and senior technical stakeholders at strategic, enterprise, federal and other key accounts — pivoting fluidly between business strategy conversations, risk, compliance, and deep technical architecture reviews.
  • Lead highly visible, multidisciplinary technical engagements of strategic importance across the region, including executive briefings, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, customer advisory feedback loops, and partner or analyst-facing discussions.
  • Represent Black Duck as a technical evangelist for the platform and roadmap within a region, delivering keynotes, webinars, whitepapers, and thought leadership content at industry events, and representing the company externally with press, analysts, and partners.
  • Translate Black Duck platform AI/ML, detection engine, and platform architecture capabilities into clear, credible narratives for both technical and executive audiences, speaking candidly to responsible AI practices such as data privacy, model governance, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Partner with Sales and Presales leadership on the region’s most strategic and enterprise opportunities, leading technical deep-dives, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, and executive briefings, and advising on the technical implications of new product launches, roadmap changes, and competitive positioning.
  • Support RFPs and security questionnaires with authoritative technical input, and articulate competitive and technical differentiation, including nuanced comparisons of AI/ML capabilities against alternatives in the market.
  • Proactively engage strategic accounts to strengthen technical trust, identify expansion opportunities, mitigate renewal risk, and guide customers toward secure software development and application security maturity.
  • Identify and solve problems of strategic or industry scope, using innovative approaches to remove technical barriers, strengthen customer confidence, and improve business outcomes.
  • Provide field-informed guidance on emerging AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, application security trends, and competitive market dynamics that may influence Black Duck strategy or customer adoption.
  • Capture, synthesize, and escalate regional customer, partner, and market feedback into actionable input for Product, Engineering, and Sales systematically capturing technical objections and influencing the roadmap, packaging, launch readiness, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Coach, enable, and review technical storytelling by sales engineers and account executives, including how to explain AI features accurately without overclaiming.

Qualifications and Experience Required:

  • 15+ years in a senior technical leadership role (CTO, Sales Engineering leader, Principal Architect, or equivalent), including several years in a customer-facing or field/pre-sales capacity.
  • Proven track record engaging and influencing C-level and senior technical audiences at enterprise organizations, with demonstrated success across complex enterprise sales cycles.
  • Domain expertise in application security (SAST, SCA, DAST), enterprise architecture, cloud/SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and security best practices.
  • Deep, practical understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, large language models, behavioral analytics, AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows), along with a candid grasp of their limitations and the practical limitations and controls needed for responsible adoption.
  • Demonstrated success negotiating with and influencing executive leadership, significant customers, partners, analysts, or vendors to shape technical decisions and business outcomes.
  • Ability to exercise wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches for complex, critical assignments with material regional, functional, or market impact.
  • Experience shaping standards, methods, practices, or market-facing technical narratives within an industry or discipline.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear stories for both executive and highly technical audiences, including customers, partners, press, analysts, and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated industry presence — conference speaking, published thought leadership, active contribution to industry/analyst communities, customer advisory leadership, or comparable external technical influence.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to customer sites and industry events.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MBA or other advanced degree.

 

Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

title: Stage Marketing Associate - Growth & Events
description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Marketing Chez Lifen, nous travaillons à mieux faire circuler les données de santé pour faciliter le travail des professionnels et améliorer la coordination des soins. Cela passe aussi par notre capacité à faire connaître nos solutions aux bons interlocuteurs. Ce stage rejoint l’équipe Marketing pour renforcer ses actions de visibilité, d’acquisition et de génération de demandes pour les équipes commerciales. Le poste couvre aussi une dimension événementielle : webinaires, salons et autres rendez-vous qui permettent de rencontrer nos audiences et de faire avancer les projets marketing. Tu interviendras sur des sujets variés, avec un périmètre à construire avec ta manager. L’objectif : faire avancer des actions concrètes, mesurer leurs résultats et proposer les prochaines étapes. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Faire évoluer le site pour améliorer sa visibilité, son trafic et la conversion des visiteurs en demandes de rendez-vous. Identifier des opportunités marketing : requêtes sur lesquelles Lifen pourrait mieux se positionner, parcours à optimiser, contenus, campagnes ou partenariats à tester. Mettre en place et suivre des actions d’acquisition et de génération de leads : séquences email, campagnes, retargeting, partenariats ou activation de la base existante, selon les priorités. Appuyer l’organisation de webinaires, salons et autres événements : recherche de lieux, coordination opérationnelle, préparation des éléments nécessaires et suivi des actions associées. Analyser le comportement des visiteurs et les résultats des actions menées pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne, ce qui bloque et quoi tester ensuite. Transformer tes analyses en recommandations concrètes, puis les faire avancer avec l’équipe Marketing et les équipes commerciales. À la fin du stage, tu auras contribué à construire un pipe marketing pour une équipe commerciale, à générer du trafic, à optimiser la conversion et à organiser des actions événementielles. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Tu recherches un stage de fin d’études de 6 mois dans le cadre d’un M2. Tu as déjà acquis des bases en marketing, idéalement sur des sujets d’acquisition, de CRM, d’email marketing ou d’événementiel. Une première expérience, un projet personnel ou un travail mené dans le cadre de tes études montre que tu as déjà travaillé sur des sujets marketing. Face à un problème, tu sais chercher, comprendre le contexte, formuler une approche et aller jusqu’à une proposition concrète. Tu as envie de travailler sur des sujets variés, avec de l’autonomie et de la prise d’initiative. Nice-to-have Des connaissances en référencement, web performance ou acquisition payante. Une première pratique du scraping. Une expérience, même ponctuelle, dans l’organisation de webinaires, de salons ou d’autres événements. L’habitude d’utiliser l’intelligence artificielle pour avancer dans ton travail, tout en restant capable d’expliquer et de challenger ce que tu produis. Soft skills Tu es curieux·se, organisé·e et tu apprends vite. Tu ne te contentes pas d’exécuter une demande telle quelle : tu cherches à comprendre le problème, tu vas chercher les informations qui te manquent et tu proposes des pistes utiles. Tu sais tenir un sujet opérationnel dans la durée, coordonner les interlocuteurs concernés et demander de l’aide quand c’est nécessaire. Le diplôme ou l’école ne feront pas la différence : ce qui compte, c’est ce que tu as déjà appris, ce que tu veux comprendre et le soin que tu mets dans ton travail. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity : tu sais découper un sujet large, tester des pistes et relier les résultats aux enjeux marketing et commerciaux. Bienveillance : tu échanges simplement avec tes interlocuteurs, tu écoutes les retours et tu construis avec eux. Real Impact : tes actions doivent aider à accroître la visibilité de Lifen, générer du trafic qualifié et créer des occasions de rencontre avec nos audiences. 👥 Process de recrutement Le process est volontairement court : Entretien initial - 30 minutes Avec Pauline, ta future manager. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ton intérêt pour le stage, tes premières expériences ou projets marketing, ainsi que ta manière d’aborder un problème. Use case préparé en amont, puis présentation live - 60 min Tu recevras un cas à préparer avant l’échange. Tu présenteras ensuite ton raisonnement, les informations que tu es allé·e chercher et les actions que tu proposes. Nous évaluerons surtout ta curiosité, ton autonomie, ta compréhension des enjeux marketing et ta capacité à faire des choix. Nous partageons un retour sous 48 heures ouvrées après chaque étape et prenons la décision finale sous deux jours ouvrés après le dernier entretien. title: Applied AI Engineer
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're building agents that run real parts of our business, take on real work, and get better based on the results they produce. You'll build them with whatever is most capable right now: our own agents platform, the latest orchestration tools, and frontier models. The hard part is making them reliable, measurable, and safe enough for the business to depend on. You'll sit in Marketing Engineering and be forward-deployed to our growth pods, where you'll find the problems worth solving and own the solutions end to end. You might be a forward-deployed builder, an applied AI engineer who has taken agents beyond the demo stage, or a full-stack engineer who is curious about growth. Requirements Python, SQL, LLM APIs and agent orchestration You've shipped production systems that other people relied on, starting from a vague problem You've built with LLMs beyond a demo and know how to evaluate them and where they fail You measure whether what you built worked Bonus: experience with GTM data or marketing systems. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're building agents that run real parts of our business, take on real work, and get better based on the results they produce. You'll build them with whatever is most capable right now: our own agents platform, the latest orchestration tools, and frontier models. The hard part is making them reliable, measurable, and safe enough for the business to depend on.

You'll sit in Marketing Engineering and be forward-deployed to our growth pods, where you'll find the problems worth solving and own the solutions end to end. You might be a forward-deployed builder, an applied AI engineer who has taken agents beyond the demo stage, or a full-stack engineer who is curious about growth.

Requirements

  • Python, SQL, LLM APIs and agent orchestration

  • You've shipped production systems that other people relied on, starting from a vague problem

  • You've built with LLMs beyond a demo and know how to evaluate them and where they fail

  • You measure whether what you built worked

  • Bonus: experience with GTM data or marketing systems.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
