  • Maintain & Iterate: Update agents continuously as Samsara's product evolves, Customer Success playbooks change, and real-world data indicates what needs improvement.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH

In your first 30 days

  • Embed with the Commercial Customer Success team to understand what Customer Success Managers actually do — their workflows, their friction points, and the customer moments that move the needle
  • Get fluent in Samsara's platform, data model, and existing Customer Success tooling stack
  • Define success metrics and an evaluation framework for the first agent on the roadmap — before you write a single line of code

In your first 90 days

  • Ship the first production agentic solution that meaningfully improves customer outcomes that lead to revenue retention and/or growth
  • Build the monitoring and iteration loop from day one — so you have a clear signal on what's working, what's drifting, and what needs to change
  • Spec the second agentic solution to detect and mitigate risk within accounts and start building, applying lessons from the first
  • Provide an estimated start date for the value gap detection and product consultation — identifies underutilization and leads product consultations via text or call.

By the end of your first year

  • Own a portfolio of three or more production agentic solutions running reliably in the Commercial Customer Success motion — and a clear maintenance cadence that keeps them current as the product and playbooks evolve
  • Demonstrate the impact of agentic solutions on reduced customer time to value, reduced time spent detecting and resolving risks, and increased retention
  • Have a track record of improving solutions after launch: performance improvements measured in real customer outcomes, not just benchmark scores
  • Be the go-to expert at Samsara for customer-facing agentic AI development — advising Customer Success leadership on what to build next, what to retire, and how to evaluate ideas before committing to them
  • Help define what great looks like for ing at Samsara, setting a standard others can build on towards using AI to expand the pipeline

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production LLM-based agents or automations
  • Python proficiency and a track record of connecting AI to external systems: CRMs, APIs, customer data, and operational tools
  • The discipline to define what success looks like before you start building — and an eval framework that catches problems before your users do
  • A genuine curiosity about Customer Success workflows and customer problems, not just the technical challenge
  • Intellectual honesty about what AI can and can't do well — and the judgment to design guardrails and fallback paths accordingly
  • 3+ years of software engineering or technical experience, with at least 1 year working hands-on with LLMs or AI agents in a production environment
  • Experience in a B2B SaaS environment

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Direct experience with Anthropic Claude or similar LLM APIs
  • A background working with or alongside a Customer Success or Revenue Operations team
  • Experience building regression test suites or eval frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar CRM and Customer Success platforms

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW

  • You'll be first: This function doesn't exist yet. You'll define the role, the standard, and the playbook for ing in Customer Success
  • The problem is real: A Customer Success Manager managing 350+ accounts can't do everything manually. AI agents aren't a nice-to-have — they're what makes this motion sustainable at Samsara's scale.
  • The timing is right: The models have caught up to the use cases. Samsara has the customer data, the platform context, and the Customer Success team to make these agents genuinely powerful.

Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What You'll Do

This is a senior role for someone who has already shipped products real people love and is ready to own entire product surfaces from idea to impact.

You'll be tasked with a large variety of projects. We're still small enough that engineers are expected to have a wide skillset and go from idea conception to feature success. We're looking for product engineers, people whose instinct is to ask "what should we build and why" before "how do we build it." You're technical enough to ship the whole thing yourself, but your superpower is product judgment, user empathy, and taste. You have strong opinions about product details — loading states, empty states, the copy on a button, and you notice friction others miss.

Most of the things we work on are parts of the core product (an end-to-end pipeline for building computer vision projects spanning image ingestion to annotation to training and deployment), but from time to time we're also working on things like integrating marketing and sales tools, automating internal processes, and open source projects.

You'll help set the roadmap, not receive it. You'll be expected to advocate for which projects are the highest priority, contribute directly to strategy decisions, and bring engineers and users along with you. If you need a rigid list of tasks spelled out in a multi-month roadmap, this role won't be a good fit.

Example Projects

  • Identifying a flow our users quietly hate and redesigning it end-to-end.

  • Next-generation model-assisted labeling.

  • Streamlining our onboarding flow.

  • Expanding our annotation tool to support new functionality (like polygonal annotations for image segmentation).

  • Creating a filtering interface so our users can mix and match their images based on metadata like the time of day they were captured, the GPS location, or custom tags they've applied.

  • Integrating the core app with external APIs for things like outsourcing annotation tasks and analyzing deployed model performance.

  • Deeper integrations with our other products like Roboflow Universe and our REST API.

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of ~120 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

You will directly be working with our Engineering Lead and a team of Engineers.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is fully distributed. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

The target compensation for this role is $165,000 - $195,000.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • $350/mo AI Tools stipend

  • $150/mo team lunch stipend

  • $500/one time home office stipend

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process (6+ hours)

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We are all motivated to work with an exceptional team and don't currently have in-house recruiters. You will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive at Roboflow. We like to be decisive and work fast, so don't be surprised if all the below conversations happen over a day or two.

  • [60m] Collaborate with a Roboflow engineer to ideate and begin building a project with Roboflow.

Build with Roboflow:

  • You will build a small project with Roboflow to showcase your technical and product skills.

  • [45m] Meet with your hiring manager or our CTO to demo your project

Final Interviews:

title: CDI - Junior Digital & Data Marketing Consultant – Paris
description:
Qui sommes-nous?

Artefact est une nouvelle génération de société spécialisée dans le conseil en data et en marketing digital data-driven, dont les 2500 employés répartis sur 27 pays ont pour mission de transformer les données de nos clients en impact business tangible.

La société est née en France en 2014 et à connu une croissance forte, sur son métier historique, le conseil data marketing, mais aussi progressivement sur tous les cas d’usages data appliqués à l’entreprise. Artefact est soutenu par des investisseurs de premier plan (Cinven), européens, et qui visent à bâtir un leader mondial dans son secteur.

Le département Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact 

Au sein des bureaux parisiens, l’équipe Digital & Data Marketing d’Artefact France est composée de 65 consultants dont le rôle est de construire les stratégies digital marketing les plus adaptées aux enjeux de nos clients, de les déployer et d’en mesurer la performance. 

En fonction des besoins des clients, nous aurons un rôle de conseil (stratégie, diagnostic de performance, modèle opérationnel, feuille de route, …) et/ou un rôle de mise en oeuvre avec les opérations de campagne et le déploiement de mesure du ROI (attribution/incrémentalité/MMM)

Ces projets s’appuient sur une expertise complète des canaux marketing et des plateformes en Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatique, Retail media, mais aussi sur une expertise et en plein développement du GEO.


Missions

Le/a consultant(e) marketing digital et data intervient dans le cadre de projets à forte valeur transformationnelle pour les équipes de nos clients. Épaulé de spécialistes du marketing digital et encadré par un manager/directeur, il est responsable de l’exécution des projets. Son objectif ultime est de concevoir des réponses marketing, média et data en réponse aux problématiques business de ses clients. Ses principales missions sont :

  • Cadrage et orchestration des projets : interviews clients et partenaires, mise en place de workshops,  préparation des uses cases
  • Construction de roadmaps et d'analyses marketing : performance média, business, études concurrentielles, créatives, analyses d’audience
  • Formulation et présentation de recommandations stratégiques pour le client, et mise en place avec les équipes clients ou internes (stratégie de mesure, campagne média, setup d’audience, audit de performance digitale, …)

Vous êtes ?

  • Issu(e) d’une formation école de commerce, vous bénéficiez d’un niveau bac +4/5 ou supérieur.
  • Vous avez une première expérience en stage ou en alternance
  • Vous possédez un fort intérêt pour le domaine du marketing digital
  • Vous êtes curieux/se, proactif/ve, autonome, à l’écoute. Vous avez une prise de parole structurée et synthétique ainsi qu’une facilité à travailler en équipe. 

Pourquoi postuler ?

  • Développement professionnel :  évaluation de performance semestrielle avec promotion potentielle ; trainings day mensuel ; développement des compétences via outils internes innovants.
  • Développement personnel : collaborez avec les experts dans leur domaine, vous apprendrez des meilleurs ; feedbacks réguliers via parrain, managers, équipes et HRBP.
  • Environnement de travail unique :  équipe jeune (moyenne d'âge 28 ans);  flexibilité télétravail ; séminaires d’équipe, entreprise ; localisation idéale dans Paris 9ème !
  • Package salarial compétitif, en adéquation avec vos compétences et expériences.

Package de rémunération : 35k€ fixe à 40k€ fixe + 3k de variable

Process de recrutement : 

  1. HR
  2. Entretien technique, un(e) Manager ou Directeur + Partner

Chez Artefact, nous recrutons nos collaborateurs uniquement en fonction de nos besoins et des qualités propres de chaque candidat. Nous assurons le développement de leurs compétences professionnelles et de leurs responsabilités sans discrimination d’aucune sorte, notamment de croyances, de genre, d’âge, de situation d'handicap, d’origine ethnique, d’orientation sexuelle, d’appartenance à une organisation politique, religieuse, syndicale ou à une minorité.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre :

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable. A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

 

Inclusion et diversité : 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. description:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox – ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
description: Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us! About AMBOSS AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.” Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why Systems at AMBOSS? AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care. Why can this position be exciting for you? You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module. You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day. This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue. Where we are Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead. You will: Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model. Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work. Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant. Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved. Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions. Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible. Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it. You bring: Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases). Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags). Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT. Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools. Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements. Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use. Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues. Nice to have: Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT Proficiency in German Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate A Workday consulting or CoE background A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context You enjoy: Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months. Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands. Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait. Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first. What success looks like after your first year: The tenant runs without the implementation partner. The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does. The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end. Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on. Benefits: 🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more) 🥙Food & Office Comfort ( Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town) 🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…) Check out the full list of benefits below: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺 Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Nous recherchons un·e Lead Data Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe Recouvrement Dans ce rôle, tu seras chargé·e d’orienter la stratégie de recouvrement B2C en te basant sur l’analyse de nos données client et des opérations de recouvrement. Pour cela, il faudra mesurer l’impact des actions existantes, construire des rapports d’analyse et proposer des orientations stratégiques pour améliorer les taux de recouvrement et gérer le risque crédit. Tu accompagneras les équipes Recouvrement et Finance dans leurs prises de décisions et d’amélioration des processus de recouvrement d’Octopus Energy France. Tu reporteras à la Manager Recouvrement et Risque-Crédit, et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes recouvrement, ops et finance. Tes missions : Être moteur dans la mise en place de la stratégie et des priorités du recouvrement pour l’entreprise Développer, maintenir et partager des reportings et des analyses data complexes en lien avec la dette, le recouvrement et plus largement la Finance pour Octopus Energy France Être force de proposition sur la mise en place des processus de recouvrement et des mesures de prévention pour garantir une excellente expérience client (par ex. : adaptation de mensualité, échelonnement de dettes) Optimiser les décisions de crédit à partir de la données (A/B tests de workflow, décision de seuils) Modéliser la dette en collaboration avec les différentes équipes Finance en France et Groupe pour du provisionnement Développer la collaboration étroite entre ton équipe et les équipes Data France , et intervenir dans les instances de reporting auprès du COMEX France et du Groupe. Les plus : Tu as une connaissances des sujets recouvrement / crédit ("plus" supplémentaire si c'est dans le secteur/contexte de l'Énergie), Tu as une connaissance des environnements data/cloud (GCP), et des outils d'automatisation, Tu as une connaissance du Machine Learning et de l’IA. Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant ! Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment ! Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.




Nous recherchons un·e Lead Data Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe Recouvrement

Dans ce rôle, tu seras chargé·e d’orienter la stratégie de recouvrement B2C en te basant sur l’analyse de nos données client et des opérations de recouvrement.

Pour cela, il faudra mesurer l’impact des actions existantes, construire des rapports d’analyse et proposer des orientations stratégiques pour améliorer les taux de recouvrement et gérer le risque crédit.

Tu accompagneras les équipes Recouvrement et Finance dans leurs prises de décisions et d’amélioration des processus de recouvrement d’Octopus Energy France. Tu reporteras à la Manager Recouvrement et Risque-Crédit, et travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes recouvrement, ops et finance.


Tes missions :
  • Être moteur dans la mise en place de la stratégie et des priorités du recouvrement pour l’entreprise

  • Développer, maintenir et partager des reportings et des analyses data complexes en lien avec la dette, le recouvrement et plus largement la Finance pour Octopus Energy France 

  • Être force de proposition sur  la mise en place des processus de recouvrement et des mesures de prévention pour garantir une excellente expérience client (par ex. : adaptation de mensualité, échelonnement de dettes)

  • Optimiser les décisions de crédit à partir de la données (A/B tests de workflow, décision de seuils)

  • Modéliser la dette en collaboration avec les différentes équipes Finance en France et Groupe pour du provisionnement

  • Développer la collaboration étroite entre ton équipe et les équipes Data France, et intervenir dans les instances de reporting auprès du COMEX France et du Groupe.
    • Ce poste inclus également le management direct de 2 collègues, 1 Data analyst expérimenté et 1 data scientist : accompagnement quotidien, montée en compétences technique, évolution chez Octopus, etc.

    Profil recherché :
    Les essentiels :
  • Tu as un solide bagage en analyse et pilotage de données, comme Analytics Engineer ou Data analyst par exemple ; idéalement dans les secteurs de la finance ou de la Tech,
  • Tu as d’excellentes compétences sur la stack data moderne : Python, SQL, DBT, Git notamment ; tu sais utiliser ces outils pour développer des analyses complexes et proposer des recommandations stratégiques,
  • Tu as au moins une 1ère expérience en management direct,
  • Tu es rigoureux·se et proactif·ve dans l’amélioration de tes reportings et des tes analyses
  • Tu t’appropries tes sujets et tu les fais avancer,
  • Tu sais gérer des projets impliquant de multiples équipes en interne,
  • Tu es à l’aise avec les outils de visualisation de données d’une manière générale,
  • Tu es capable de synthétiser des analyses de manière claire, en quelques slides ou lignes par exemple.
    • Les plus : 
  • Tu as une connaissances des sujets recouvrement / crédit ("plus" supplémentaire si c'est dans le secteur/contexte de l'Énergie),
  • Tu as une connaissance des environnements data/cloud (GCP), et des outils d'automatisation,
  • Tu as une connaissance du Machine Learning et de l’IA.

    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si :
  • Tu aimes contribuer et faire avancer la stratégie d’une équipe
  • Tu es pédagogue et as envie de participer à la montée en compétences technique de ton équipe
  • Tu sais travailler de manière collaborative et avec différentes équipes
  • Tu es un·e problem-solver et tu fais avancer tes projets
  • Tu es rigoureux·se et proactif·ve
  • Tu sais travailler en Français et en Anglais (niveau min C1), pour pouvoir communiquer avec nos collègues du groupe et d’outre-Manche 
  • Tu partages notre ambition de révolutionner le monde de l’énergie !

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? 

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

You will focus on large French enterprises, navigating complex procurement ecosystems and strategic decision-makers. · Create and maintain security procedures, incident-response playbooks, operational documentation and technical standards.

· You have at least 5 years of professional experience in Security Operations, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security or a related field (network, systems or cloud engineering with a strong security component). 

· You have practical experience with security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, system hardening and operational security. 

Mindset & collaboration 

· You are passionate about cybersecurity and interested in automation and the DevOps culture; you would rather automate a process than repeat it.

· Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog. 

· Ability to script and automate repetitive operational or security tasks. 

Nice to have 

· Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform or an equivalent cloud environment. 

· An active interest in security news, emerging threats, conferences and meetups.

· Automation: Ansible, AWX, Terraform

· Security tooling: SIEM, EDR, WAF, antivirus, PKI 

· Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog

Lead the global operational organisation to deliver rockets safely, to the required quality, on time and at the planned cost. Own execution across manufacturing, assembly, integration, engine testing and launch-pad AIT, building a consistent operating system and the capacity needed to increase production and launch cadence.

Secure capacity, trained teams, controlled procedures and complete records, ensuring propulsion systems and rockets meet agreed acceptance and readiness criteria.
  • HSE, quality and readiness: Lead Global HSE, embedding risk assessment, safe work, environmental controls, incident learning and emergency readiness. Site leaders own implementation. With Quality, close conformity and readiness gaps, respecting independent acceptance authority.
  • Global maintenance: Own the maintenance strategy, preventive and predictive programmes, critical spares and asset performance. Ensure competent teams and planned interventions sustain equipment availability, test capacity and safe operation across sites.
  • Capacity and scale: Deliver the operational capacity commitments agreed through enterprise planning and SIOP. Identify constraints in people, skills, equipment, facilities and test throughput; implement approved interventions and ramp-up plans.
  • Future launch pads: Lead operational mobilisation of new launch-pad AIT teams, including organisation, staffing, training, equipment, procedures and handover readiness. Coordinate with infrastructure, logistics and launch operations leaders.
  • Isar Production System: Develop and deploy the Isar Production System to drive operational excellence across Munich manufacturing and global AIT. Embed Lean daily management, standard work, visual performance, problem solving and improvement routines. Empower leaders to own performance and build capability, with maturity reviews and shared learning across sites.

Leadership and operating model

  • People and accountability: Develop directors, MD Sweden and global HSE/Maintenance leaders. Define regional and functional responsibilities, resource commitments and escalation routes; resolve conflicting priorities.
  • Operational governance: Run daily and weekly delivery reviews, manage cross-site escalations and provide forward-looking SIOP inputs. Report plan versus forecast, top constraints, readiness risks and decisions required; ensure actions are closed.
  • Resilience and logistics: Maintain operational recovery capability and tested site continuity plans within the enterprise framework. Coordinate engine and rocket movements with Logistics, ensuring transport, receipt and handover support the delivery plan.
  • Digital thread and AI: Improve connected operational information across MES, ERP, PLM and test systems. Apply AI and automation to analysis, reporting and workflows to improve departmental efficiency, with reliable data and accountable review.

Qualification Checklist 

  • Operations leadership: Senior multi-site operations leadership in aerospace, space or complex manufacturing, with a record of delivering safety, quality, output, cost and schedule performance.
  • Manufacturing and AIT: Strong experience in manufacturing, assembly, integration and test, including complex hardware acceptance and operational readiness. Engine test or launch-site experience is desirable.
  • Industrialisation and scale: Proven ability to increase capacity and throughput, establish new teams or sites, and manage cross-site dependencies and operational recovery.
  • Leadership and improvement: Able to lead through senior managers, develop accountable teams and deploy Lean management with sustained results. Relevant technical qualification or equivalent experience.
  • AI capability — required: Demonstrable practical use of AI and automation to improve departmental efficiency, supported by measurable outcomes. Able to lead adoption and strengthen digital operational visibility

Aim radically high • Deliver, no excuses • Act with trust and integrity • Mission first, always

Benefits 

  • Employee Participation Program: Share in our success through our virtual company share program
  • 30 days of vacation: Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge
  • Company pension plan: Secure your future with our company pension plan, featuring a 20% employer contribution after the probation period
  • Subsidised lunch: Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day
  • Flexible mobility budget: Travel your way with a choice between a fully financed Deutschlandticket, JobRad bicycle leasing, FINN JobAuto, or a fuel allowance
  • Rental clothing with laundry service: Enjoy hassle-free workwear with our convenient rental clothing and laundry service  
  • Sport Clubs membership: Stay fit with our sponsored sports club memberships (EGYM Wellpass)

  • Childcare allowance: Receive a childcare allowance for your non-school-age children
  • And Much More! Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.

We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.

Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.

We are a fast-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

As a Program Manager at STARK, you will lead one of our core hardware programs taking it from early R&D all the way to production readiness. You’ll be responsible for translating ambitious technical concepts into operational products and building the team that makes it happen.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated Chief Engineer, combining program leadership with technical direction. Together, you’ll shape the vision, align priorities, and drive execution across engineering, production, and business functions.

A key part of your mission will be to build and scale a world-class engineering team, recruiting top talent, defining structure, and fostering a high-performance culture that moves fast, collaborates openly, and delivers. You’ll also coordinate with shared engineering functions (simulation, testing, systems, etc.) to allocate resources effectively and ensure critical work gets the attention it needs.

This role is about ownership and leadership: Building both a product and the organization that delivers it.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • End-to-End Program Leadership: Own the delivery of a major hardware program from R&D, to go-to-market verification to production readiness.
  • Team Building: Build, structure, and grow a high-performing multidisciplinary team. Recruit top engineering talent and create an environment where they can deliver their best work.
  • Partnership with Chief Engineer: Co-lead the program, pairing strong technical direction with decisive program leadership.
  • Strategic Planning: Translate strategic goals into clear milestones, deliverables, and resource plans.
  • Execution & Prioritization: Drive focus on what matters most. Keep teams aligned, proactive, and moving fast.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Connect the dots across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and business functions to maintain alignment and momentum.
  • Program–Portfolio Alignment: Work closely with the VP Programs to ensure key programs get the focus and resources needed to deliver cutting-edge technology to customers at record speed.
  • Leadership & Culture: Set high standards, communicate clearly, and keep teams motivated and accountable even in demanding phases.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Deliver concise, transparent updates on progress, risks, and key decisions to leadership.
  • Process & Structure: Implement pragmatic governance and scalable processes that enable speed without bureaucracy.

  • Experience: 4–10 years in program or project management, ideally in hardware, aerospace, robotics, or defense. Proven experience leading complex technical programs and growing teams.
  • Background: Technical or technically literate background: e.g. engineering, industrial engineering, or technical management. You don’t need to design systems yourself, but you must understand how engineers think and work.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams. You attract talent, set structure, and keep people aligned through clarity and purpose.
  • Mindset: Mission-driven, decisive, and pragmatic. You thrive in ambiguity and bring structure to complexity. You seek feedback, learn fast, and raise your own bar continuously.
  • Communication: Clear, direct communicator with strong written and verbal skills in English and German.
  • Execution: Strong bias for action: >ou get things done, stay close to the details, and drive accountability.
  • Tools: Comfortable with modern program tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Excel, and PMO systems).

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Operations team at Stark builds and maintains the core data pipelines, sensor logging, and annotation workflows that feed our AI and perception models. Operating at the intersection of hardware testing, flight logs, and machine learning, the team ensures high-throughput, high-fidelity data availability. We work closely with ML Engineers, perception experts, and external labeling partners to scale training data for autonomous defence systems.

YOUR MISSION

You are the crucial bridge between our raw field data, our external labeling partners, and our internal Machine Learning teams. Your mission is to ensure our AI models are trained on the highest quality data possible. You will own the day-to-day operations of the data labeling lifecycle: curating raw data, preparing annotation batches, managing vendor communication, and rigorously assessing the quality of incoming labels. If you are highly organized, detail-oriented, and interested in the intersection of data operations and Computer Vision, this is the perfect place to start your career in AI.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Own the day-to-day data labeling lifecycle: curate raw field data, create annotation batches, and prepare deliveries for external labeling companies.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for external data annotation vendors, clarifying edge cases and providing feedback on labeling guidelines.
  • Conduct rigorous Quality Assurance (QA) assessments on incoming label deliveries, track error rates, and create performance reports.
  • Support data curation efforts, filtering and selecting the most valuable sensor data (images, video, lidar) for model training.
  • Work closely with ML Engineers to understand their data needs, edge cases, and specific Computer Vision requirements.
  • Help maintain the data catalog by ensuring incoming datasets are properly tagged and logged.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented: you can manage multiple data batches, vendor deliveries, and QA processes simultaneously without dropping the ball.
  • Strong communication skills: you are comfortable coordinating with external vendors and writing clear, unambiguous instructions/guidelines.
  • Basic understanding of Computer Vision and Machine Learning concepts (e.g., bounding boxes, segmentation masks, object tracking).
  • Comfortable with basic scripting (Python) and data querying (SQL) to automate small tasks or filter data batches.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver who enjoys bringing order to chaotic data deliveries.
  • Fluent in English.

Wirkungsvoll, hands-on und pragmatisch: Bei AlixPartners treibt Ihre Leidenschaft Ihre Karriere – durch hohe Leistung, Initiative und Resultate. Sie liefern schnell umsetzbare Lösungen für dringende Fragestellungen, oft in (zeit-) kritischen Situationen, bei denen viel auf dem Spiel steht.

Durch unseren One-Firm Firm Ansatz bieten wir länderübergreifende Möglichkeiten für Weiterbildung sowie zur persönlichen und professionellen Entwicklung.

Außerdem erwartet Sie ein attraktives Gehaltspaket mit umfassenden Benefits und zahlreiche Initiativen unserer Employer Resource Groups – sprechen Sie uns gerne darauf an.

Business Management Consulting:

  • Als AI & Data Consultant werden Sie eine Schlüsselrolle spielen, indem Sie nicht nur die Geschäftsabläufe unserer Kunden optimieren, sondern auch zukunftsweisende KI-Strategien entwerfen, welche die Wettbewerbsposition unserer Kunden dauerhaft verbessern.
  • Sie übersetzen komplexe Geschäftsprobleme in umsetzbare Technologiekonzepte und präsentieren wichtige Erkenntnisse und Lösungen auf Managementebene.

Data and Technology:

  • Extrahierung, Verarbeitung und Analyse von Daten aus einer Vielzahl von strukturierten und unstrukturierten Unternehmensquellen, Drittanbietern und öffentlich verfügbaren Daten.
  • Nutzung von Cloud-Datenverarbeitungs-Frameworks wie Apache Spark, Databricks o.ä. zur Verarbeitung und Analyse komplexer, großer Datenmengen.
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit der Nutzung von Cloud-Produkten und -Lösungen über APIs, insbesondere MS Azure und AWS.
  • Entwurf mehrstufiger Datenpipelines, die skriptgesteuerte Transformationen und API-Aufrufe zu verschiedenen Diensten kombinieren.

Data Science:

  • Einsatz von Python oder R zur Analyse und Modellierung komplexer und umfangreicher Daten.
  • Entwicklung und Anwendung von Modellen für Clustering, Klassifikation, Regression, Anomalieerkennung, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung oder GenAI.

title: Lead Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ427R476

Location: Remote, Germany

At Databricks, we build the platform that makes data and AI usable across an entire organization, not just in a specialist team. Our customers come to us with problems that have no template, and the Solutions Architects are the people who work those problems out with them.

As a Lead Solutions Architect, you own our most complex enterprise relationships in the region, technically and commercially, and you act as a recognized voice in the wider data community. You will be measured by the impact you have on those accounts and on the Solutions Architects around you.

The impact you will have

  • Lead and manage complex enterprise accounts with custom requirements, from the first technical conversation through to production.
  • Deliver compelling demos and pitches to budget holders and C-level stakeholders.
  • Turn customer conversations into working prototypes fast, using AI-assisted development to build demos in hours rather than weeks.
  • Mentor and develop Solutions Architects and Senior SAs together with Field Engineering leadership.
  • Build Databricks' technical presence in the DACH market through customer-facing collateral, workshops, meetups, and conference talks.
  • Develop and roll out best practices and repeatable processes across the region.
  • Establish close working relationships with internal SMEs, product teams, and leadership.

What we look for

  • Fluent German and business-level English. Both are used daily with customers and internally.
  • Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, including complex customer interactions across the full sales lifecycle.
  • Ability to drive technical and business conversations with C-level executives, orchestrate cross-functional teams, and influence outcomes toward long-term customer success.
  • Strong track record in the data landscape, with deep expertise in at least one of data engineering or data science.
  • Hands-on coding ability in Python and SQL.
  • Daily, fluent use of AI tools in your own work. Coding assistants and agents are part of how you operate, not something you try out occasionally.
  • Able to vibe-code a demo: assemble a credible, working prototype for a specific customer problem with AI assistance, and recognize where the output still needs your own judgment.
  • Hands-on experience running complex proofs of concept on at least one major public cloud.
  • Judgment to prioritize the right use cases and investments, and to navigate a competitive landscape.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

title: (Senior) Accounting Manager (f/m/x)
description:
Your mission

You will bring accounting in-house at SPARETECH, globally, for our German GmbH and our US Inc. You will be hands-on with bookkeeping, revenue recognition, and consolidation, and you will strategically move them onto one scalable global Accounting solution.

As our business grows, you will make sure our accounting is accurate, high quality, and compliant with German and US requirements, giving SPARETECH a reliable financial foundation for every next step.

We offer you the opportunity to  

  • Build from the ground up: Bring accounting in-house from external advisors and set up a function that scales with the business.
  • Own accounting globally: Take full responsibility for bookkeeping, month-end close, and annual financial statements for our German and US entities.
  • Run the core processes: Own revenue recognition, purchase-to-pay, and order-to-cash accounting, as well as correct balance sheet bookings and asset tracking.
  • Bring the group together: Design and run a clear consolidation process across both entities.
  • Choose the tools: Select and roll out a scalable global accounting and consolidation solution, building on today's setup of DATEV in Germany and NetSuite in the US.
  • Partner with experts: Work with our tax advisors and with auditors as the go-to person for accounting.
  • Grow fast: Take on new challenges as our business, products, and reporting requirements grow, with a steep learning curve.
  • Work your way: Work fully remote from anywhere in Germany, in close collaboration with our VP Finance and a small, hands-on finance team.

Become part of our team if you 

  • Bring experience: Have ideally 3 to 8 years of accounting experience, including accounting in a startup. Experience at a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm is a plus.
  • Know German GAAP: Have strong knowledge of German GAAP (HGB), including experience with consolidation.
  • Understand SaaS revenue: Have experience with revenue recognition in a SaaS or subscription business.
  • Have a solid foundation: Hold a university degree in accounting, finance, or business. A professional qualification such as ACCA or CPA is a plus.
  • Add an international view: Bring knowledge of US accounting standards (US GAAP), or experience with DATEV, NetSuite, or implementing accounting software. Each is a plus.
  • Automate where it counts: Look for ways to automate processes, including with AI tools.
  • Like to get hands-on: Enjoy making the bookings yourself while keeping the bigger picture in view.
  • Take ownership: Work independently, stay pragmatic and solution-oriented in a scaling company, and enjoy building processes from scratch.
  • Keep growing: Are eager to learn and constantly seek new challenges.
  • Speak fluently: Are fluent in German and English.

You can expect 

  • A remote-yes company, where you can decide every day whether you work from home, at our Stuttgart or Munich office, or at any Design Office in Germany.
  • A permanent employment contract, 30 days of vacation, and the opportunity to participate in the company's success through our VSOP program.
  • Modern hardware and the frame for a height-adjustable desk.
  • An annual training budget of 1000€ for your professional development.
  • A subsidized job bike to escape city traffic and a Wellpass gym membership to stay active.
  • To enjoy Corporate Benefits, including discounts on fashion, travel, and much more from various companies.
  • A dynamic start-up atmosphere and an international team in which new ideas, creative approaches, and cooperation at eye level are valued.

About SPARETECH

SPARETECH's vision is to empower the zero-waste industrial sharing economy by enabling maintenance and procurement teams at manufacturing leaders like Bosch, Porsche, and Nestlé to reduce MRO spend and optimize inventory through accurate part information, internal transparency, and market visibility.

To achieve this, we have built, and continue to build, an AI-powered MRO software that connects all players in the spare parts ecosystem, from manufacturers and suppliers to the people working behind the machines. By facilitating the exchange of data, knowledge, and expertise, we create shared visibility that empowers smarter decisions, reduces waste, and drives seamless collaboration. This connected spare parts intelligence unlocks value that extends far beyond software.

Backed by Insight Partners, SPARETECH is accelerating its growth with a strong focus on product innovation and team excellence. We take pride in our inclusive and collaborative culture, as well as our energetic and committed team.

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

title: Senior Software Engineer | Middleware
description: At ExtraHop , we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. Location This position is remote within the United States. Living in the Seattle, WA area is preferred but not required. Position Summary Join the Middleware team as a Sr. Software Engineer and help us build a fault-resilient, highly available, and customer-centric platform. In this role you will work with the team to build a scalable and secure platform and build customer-facing features that enable security and engineering teams to stop threats in their place! This is a rewarding opportunity for someone who is obsessed with customer success, passionate about simplification, and eager to dive deep into technology best practices. Our services and features are written primarily in Python, Golang, TypeScript and React with a focus on security, scalability, stability and type-first design. Our team develops public REST APIs, solves database scalability challenges, implements data migrations, and enables configuration management across our fleet of services. The R(x) 360 Platform is built on AWS and GCP. It utilizes Terraform to define Infrastructure-as-Code and our services. This platform allows us to build native product and service integrations, first-class customer-facing workflows, and high throughput data pipelines. Our goal is to build a reliable platform for customer-facing services while encouraging healthy work-life balance via automated remediation and fault-tolerant designs. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain services written in Go and Python powering ExtraHop’s products. Lead and participate actively in agile development processes, code reviews, and technical strategy discussions. Provide technical leadership to junior team members and leverage design and mentorship experience to help enable the team Act as a technical expert, fostering a culture of excellence, curiosity and collaborative problem solving. Address technical debt proactively, continually improving our codebase and technical stack Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field 7+ years of professional backend development experience Solid knowledge of Go, Python, or an equivalent programming language Experience in API development, PostgresQL database design or SQL query performance optimization Experience building and scaling distributed, highly available systems Strong problem-solving skills, a self-starter mentality, and a track record of technical ownership. Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in fast-paced, agile environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Django, FastAPI or another Python web framework Experience with cloud services on AWS or Azure (EKS / RDS / S3 / SQS / EC2 / IAM /Lambdas) Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $180,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more. ABOUT EXTRAHOP ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise. OUR VALUES Our culture is rooted in our five Values . These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team. Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues. Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company. Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done. Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo. Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team. BENEFITS Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits: Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable Educational Reimbursement 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable Pet Insurance (US Only) Parental Leave (US Only) Hybrid and Remote Work Model Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. title: AI Engineer
description: Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide. Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 ! We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm. About the role At Phantom, we're looking for an AI Engineer to help shape how AI is adopted and scaled across the company. You'll play a key role in building the internal AI tools, integrations, and automation that enable teams to work smarter, move faster, and operate more efficiently. This is a hands on engineering role focused on turning emerging AI capabilities into practical, reliable solutions that drive meaningful business impact. You'll partner closely with teams across the organization to identify opportunities, build AI powered workflows, and establish the technical foundations that make AI accessible, secure, and scalable. We're looking for someone who enjoys building, experimenting, and shipping, with a strong understanding of modern LLM technologies and the engineering fundamentals required to bring AI solutions into production. Responsibilities Build AI Solutions: Design, develop, and deploy AI powered tools, agents, and automation that streamline workflows and solve real business problems across the organization. Develop AI Integrations: Connect LLMs and AI applications with internal systems, APIs, and enterprise tools to enable seamless, intelligent workflows. Own AI Infrastructure: Build and maintain the underlying infrastructure, services, and integrations that support reliable AI applications across teams. Enable AI Adoption: Partner with stakeholders to identify opportunities for AI, translate business needs into technical solutions, and empower teams to leverage AI tools effectively. Build for Scale: Develop reusable components, frameworks, and tooling that make it easier for teams to build, customize, and maintain their own AI workflows. Ensure Security & Reliability: Implement appropriate access controls, monitoring, observability, and operational safeguards to ensure AI solutions are secure, reliable, and maintainable. Optimize AI Usage: Monitor model performance, usage, and costs while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and business outcomes. Drive Innovation: Stay current with emerging AI technologies, evaluate new models and frameworks, and identify practical opportunities to bring new capabilities into the organization. Qualifications Strong software engineering background with experience building and maintaining production applications, services, or internal platforms. Hands on experience developing applications using LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or open source models. Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or similar programming languages, with experience integrating APIs and building backend services. Experience building AI agents, workflow automation, or applications that leverage LLM orchestration frameworks. Familiarity with retrieval augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, structured outputs, prompt engineering, and modern AI application patterns. Experience integrating applications with enterprise tools, internal systems, and third party APIs. Understanding of cloud infrastructure, deployment practices, monitoring, and production reliability. Strong product mindset with the ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical technical solutions. Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and collaborate effectively with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. A genuine interest in AI and a bias toward experimentation, execution, and measurable impact. Nice to Have Experience building internal AI platforms or enterprise AI automation solutions. Familiarity with AI coding tools, agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms. Experience with technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, or similar frameworks. Experience with MCP, enterprise connectors, and AI tool integrations. Familiarity with LLM observability, evaluation frameworks, cost optimization, and usage analytics. Experience implementing security, governance, and access controls for enterprise AI applications. Experience working in a fast growing technology company where speed, ownership, and adaptability are essential. You'll help make AI a practical and valuable part of how Phantom operates. Success means delivering solutions that teams actively use, reducing manual work, accelerating execution, and creating a scalable foundation for continued AI adoption. You'll have the opportunity to own projects from concept through production, influence our internal AI strategy, and help define how we leverage AI across the organization. Why Work With Us Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people. Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world. Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless. Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation. Benefits ( only available to full-time employees) Competitive salary and equity Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision): base plan 100% covered Flexible hours and a long-standing, supportive remote environment Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!) 401(k) retirement plan Wellness stipend Weekly meal stipend Learning & Development stipend Remote / WFH set-up stipend We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career. By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
